title.zh: 以太坊Glamsterdam升级于测试网激活，区块Gas上限已提升至约2亿

current_state.zh: Ethereum's Glamsterdam upgrade went live on the Sepolia testnet, raising the testnet block gas limit from roughly 60 million to about 200 million as developers test capacity improvements ahead of mainnet deployment.
current_state.en: Ethereum's Glamsterdam upgrade went live on the Sepolia testnet, raising the testnet block gas limit from roughly 60 million to about 200 million as developers test capacity improvements ahead of mainnet deployment.
